title: Figure 8: Location of the AAV during the F/A-18 intercept off Baja California
description: Google Earth satellite image of the Pacific coast from San Diego and Tijuana south along Baja California, with a red-circled marker offshore indicating the AAV position and a scale bar of 86 km. The caption reads "Figure 8. Location of the AAV during the F/A18 Intercept." The text describes the 14 November 2004 tasking of two F/A-18s from the USS Nimitz to investigate an unidentified airborne contact in clear weather, with the pilot's name redacted as "AAP Person 9."
